abstract: Here, we present evidence that the tumor-like growth of mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs) is suppressed by short-term serum-free culture, which is reversed by pharmacological inhibition of Gsk3β. Mouse ESCs maintained under standard conditions using fetal bovine serum (FBS) were cultured in a uniquely formulated chemically-defined serum-free (CDSF) medium, namely ESF7, for three passages before being subcutaneously transplanted into immunocompromised mice. Surprisingly, the mESCs failed to produce teratomas for up to six months, whereas mESCs maintained under standard conditions generated well-developed teratomas in five weeks. Mouse ESCs cultured under CDSF conditions maintained the expression of Oct3/4, Nanog, Sox2 and SSEA1, and differentiated into germ cells in vivo. In addition, when mESCs were cultured under CDSF conditions supplemented with FBS, or when the cells were cultured under CDSF conditions followed by standard culture conditions, they consistently developed into teratomas. Thus, these results validate that the pluripotency of mESCs was not compromised by CDSF conditions. Mouse ESCs cultured under CDSF conditions proliferated significantly more slowly than mESCs cultured under standard conditions, and were reminiscent of Eras-null mESCs. In fact, their slower proliferation was accompanied by the downregulation of Eras and c-Myc, which regulate the tumor-like growth of mESCs. Remarkably, when mESCs were cultured under CDSF conditions supplemented with a pharmacological inhibitor of Gsk3β, they efficiently proliferated and developed into teratomas without upregulation of Eras and c-Myc, whereas mESCs cultured under standard conditions expressed Eras and c-Myc. Although the role of Gsk3β in the self-renewal of ESCs has been established, it is suggested with these data that Gsk3β governs the tumor-like growth of mESCs by means of a mechanism different from the one to support the pluripotency of ESCs.
abstract_ja: 我々は、マウス胚性幹細胞(mESC)の腫瘍様増殖が短期の無血清培養によって抑制され、Gsk3β阻害剤によって回復することを示す。標準条件下でウシ胎児血清(FBS)を用いて維持したmESCと、化学的に定義された無血清(CDSF)培地ESF7で3継代培養したmESCを、免疫不全マウスに皮下移植した。驚くべきことに、CDSF条件下のmESCは6か月まで奇形腫を形成しなかったが、標準条件下のmESCは5週間で十分に発達した奇形腫を形成した。CDSF条件下のmESCはOct3/4、Nanog、Sox2、SSEA1の発現を維持し、生体内で胚細胞へ分化した。さらに、CDSF条件下でFBSを添加して培養した場合、またはCDSF条件後に標準条件で培養した場合は、一貫して奇形腫を形成した。したがって、CDSF条件によってmESCの多能性は損なわれないことが確認された。CDSF条件下のmESCは、標準条件下のmESCより有意に遅く増殖し、Eras欠損mESCに類似していた。実際、増殖の遅さはErasとc-Mycの発現低下を伴っており、これらはmESCの腫瘍様増殖を調節する。注目すべきことに、CDSF条件にGsk3β阻害剤を加えると、Erasとc-Mycの上昇がないまま効率よく増殖し奇形腫を形成したが、標準条件のmESCではErasとc-Mycが発現していた。Gsk3βはESCの自己複製に関与することが確立されているが、本データは、Gsk3βがESCの多能性を支える機構とは異なる機構によってmESCの腫瘍様増殖を制御することを示唆する。
